methods.F_attribution: F-D bundles factorized fact output and deterministic label reduction; their individual causal contributions are not isolated
methods.bootstrap: paired percentile bootstrap of equally weighted authored-family means; exploratory
methods.ci_limitations: exploratory, no multiplicity correction, 12 new authored families; no candidate/seed pseudoreplication
methods.computation: T tool execution counts and all policy planning work are reported; no LLM enumeration speedup claim
methods.cost: conservative usage bounds, not invoices; known-cost and token denominators explicit; no heldout/regression pooling
methods.fact_denominators: global fields once per world; candidate fields once per world/site; invalid responses counted invalid at every expected field
methods.family_accuracy: mean candidate accuracy within each case, then case means within family; families equally weighted
methods.historical: same 24 regression cases only; longitudinal and protocol differences remain confounders
methods.integration_strata: initial alternative feasibility uses enforcing receipt-aware _Machine/_estimate with quota16; gate sensitivity is paired all_allow versus all_block success disagreement
methods.invalid: separate invalid prediction column, included in every primary candidate-axis denominator
methods.safety_attribution: trusted grants protect alternatives; aggregate solver gates are conservative across worlds, not per-world success ceilings
methods.selective_accuracy: conditional on the entire response having correct facts; null means zero accepted denominator
